## In view of

**Word Power 48 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Considering something; taking something into account.

### Usage

1. In view of the weather, the event will be held indoors.
2. In view of the Corona virus, educational institutions remained closed almost throughout 2020 and online classes were held.

### Your turn

Use “in view of” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
